title: EMIR UTI Completeness Checker
description: Validate EMIR Refit UTI format (ISO 23897, 52 alphanumeric characters max), generating-party identity, and T+1 sharing timing: UTI must be shared with the other counterparty by 10:00 CET next business day (approximately 34-hour window). Caller supplies Unix timestamps. Returns format validity, sharing deadline, and whether the deadline was met. Zero network, zero PII.

uti.description: Unique Trade Identifier (ISO 23897, max 52 alphanumeric chars)

generating_party.description: LEI of the party that generated the UTI

uti_shared_unix.description: Unix timestamp when UTI was shared with the other counterparty
